stops.label: Outside building
stops.note: All rooms are behind the street-facing wall. Original front bays retained; the additional right wing is an estimated enclosure.

stops.label: Street entrance
stops.note: Accepted street entrance, stair/ramp and ground-floor arrangement preserved.

stops.label: Ground-floor elevators
stops.note: First-floor elevator bank retained. Both levels remain aligned in the same continuous shafts.

stops.label: Second-floor arrival
stops.note: Both lift banks remain aligned. The closed opaque white door opposite the cab leads to another room, not reception.

stops.label: Reception door destinations
stops.note: Retained reception interior moved as one assembly. Approach through the landing and cross-hall after turning left out of the elevator; original doors/furnishings retained.

stops.label: Single door → separate room
stops.note: A distinct plain room behind the single door. It does not open into the classroom; its dimensions are estimated.

stops.label: Double doors → classroom
stops.note: Both reception leaves and both classroom leaves are open across a short supported vestibule. Classroom furniture is retained.

stops.label: Inside rotated classroom
stops.note: Existing classroom moved rigidly with reception to keep the double-door connection. Room geometry, dimensions, furnishings and materials retained.

stops.label: Longer side hallway
stops.note: The hallway remains behind the single chair, before the reception glass. Its full length and far end remain estimates.

stops.label: Joined floor structure
stops.note: Lift shafts remain vertically aligned. An estimated rear support/enclosure joins the repositioned upper rooms to the ground structure; ground entrance/ramp/rooms retained.

stops.label: Furnished ground rooms
stops.note: Simple original furnishings in the brown-door room and larger area to its left. Connecting route remains clear; furnishings are illustrative.

stops.label: Arrival hallway exit
stops.note: Hallway extended about 3.3 m to an open door beneath EXIT, with a small enclosed foyer beyond. Estimated layout, not a surveyed exit route.

stops.label: Reception rear passage and room
stops.note: Door wall moved back 0.9 m for clearance past the retained reception desk. Open door leads through a passage into an estimated furnished room.

stops.label: Left turn to reception
stops.note: After the upper cab walk-out, turn left toward reception. The retained white cylinder now stands beside the connecting hallway; the widened opening reveals the cross-hall junction.

stops.label: Cross-hall before reception
stops.note: Reception lies across this junction. Hallway branches continue to both sides, and the retained white cylinder stands on the approach between reception and elevators.

routes.name: Ramp bypass to small elevator forecourt and open cab
Brown-door small room to larger left side area
Sidewalk through open street entrance, stepping onto retained 38 mm mat
Upper lift landing through new reception entry
Reception single door to separate small room
Reception double doors through classroom double opening
Cross-hall separates upper rooms and reception

classroom_status: Existing reception, classroom and connected rooms repositioned rigidly; original dimensions, furnishings/materials and single/double-door relationships retained.
exterior_status: Original street facade retained. Estimated rear ground support/enclosure fits the repositioned retained upper rooms; lift shafts and ground entrance/ramp/rooms stay fixed.
